# Japan Institute of Financial Advisors (日本金融商品仲介業協会)

> The Japan Institute of Financial Advisors (J-IFA) promotes the professionalization of independent financial advisors and investor education across Japan.

J-IFA is a general incorporated association dedicated to supporting Independent Financial Advisors (IFAs) through professional development, industry standards, and financial literacy initiatives. The organization serves as a central hub for advisor training, membership information, and investor education resources.

## Key Topics

- IFA (Independent Financial Advisor)
- Financial Literacy
- Investment Education
- NISA (Tax-Free Investment Account)
- Wealth Management
- Asset Formation
- Goal-Based Asset Management (ゴールベース資産管理)
- Financial Planning
- Professional Development
- Membership Information
- FA Conference
- Financial Advisor Training
- Japan Finance Industry
- Asset Management

## About J-IFA

- [IFA and the Future of Investors](https://www.j-ifa.or.jp/): Japan Institute of Financial Advisors homepage defining IFA support and financial advisor mission

## Financial Education & Literacy

- [Investment Education Guide](https://www.j-ifa.or.jp/literacy/): Investment education and financial literacy guide covering NISA and wealth management
